source_revision: Shopify GraphQL Admin API 2026-10 (latest stable per shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/versioning on 2026-11-01; 2025-10 is listed unsupported)
identity_rule: Not applicable: no provider object carries a hold identity.
coverage_rule: Unsupported: no holds, reserves or release promises are readable; answers depending on holds stay unknown unless a generic producer supplies them.

retention.basis: Shopify API License and Terms of Use, merchant-owned data, read-only custom app; the merchant owns its order/payout data and installs the app on its own store. Raw provider payloads are stored as sanitized evidence (no customer names/emails/addresses) under the workspace retention policy.

local_standalone.limitations: No hold objects exist at the provider.
local_standalone.reason: Shopify Payments publishes no holds/reserves/release promises; the capability is declared unsupported until a verified source exists (generic producer or a future provider report).

local_gateway.limitations: No gateway runtime exists in the pilot; declared and refused by the connector (LOCAL-07).
local_gateway.reason: local_gateway is deferred scope for the local pilot (delivery-profile.json); no gateway is provisioned and the capability declaration lists no methods for it.

public_server.limitations: No public callback is registered; localhost cannot receive Shopify webhooks.
public_server.reason: public_server is deferred scope for the local pilot; direct webhooks would require a public HTTPS endpoint that the pilot does not provide.
